adds.title: Captain America: Civil War
adds.text: In Berlin, the triggered Bucky strangles Natasha until T'Challa pulls him off. At the Leipzig airport she stops T'Challa with her stingers so Bucky and Steve can escape in the Quinjet.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Strangled by Bucky in Berlin, then lets him and Steve escape at the airport.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The Winter Soldier, who strangles Natasha in Berlin and whom she lets escape.
adds.evidence: Berlin JCTC: the triggered Winter Soldier strangles Romanoff until T'Challa intervenes; at Leipzig-Halle she tasers Black Panther so Rogers and Barnes reach the Quinjet.

adds.title: Captain America: Civil War
adds.text: Clint and Natasha fight on opposite sides at the Leipzig airport. Mid-fight she asks if they are still friends, and he jokes that it depends on how hard she hits him.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Clint's best friend, fought on opposite sides at the Leipzig airport.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Natasha's best friend, who fights her at the airport but jokes they're still friends.
adds.evidence: Leipzig-Halle Airport battle: Black Widow and Hawkeye fight; she asks if they're still friends, he says it depends how hard she hits him.

adds.title: Captain America: Civil War
adds.text: F.R.I.D.A.Y. runs Tony's armor through the airport battle and finds that the fake psychiatrist is Zemo. In Siberia, Tony has her analyze Steve's fight pattern so he can counter his blows.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: F.R.I.D.A.Y.'s creator, who has her identify Zemo and read Steve's fighting.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's A.I., who uncovers Zemo and scans Steve's fight pattern in Siberia.
adds.evidence: F.R.I.D.A.Y. assists at Leipzig-Halle, reads Rhodes's vitals, identifies Broussard's killer as Helmut Zemo, and in Siberia analyzes Captain America's fight pattern on Tony's order.

adds.title: Captain America: Civil War
adds.text: Rhodes and Natasha both sign the Sokovia Accords and fight on Tony's side at the Leipzig airport, where Rhodes is shot down.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow signer of the Accords, on Tony's side at the airport.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow signer of the Accords, shot down on Tony's side at the airport.
adds.evidence: Romanoff tells Rogers that Stark, Rhodes and Vision have signed; both are on Stark's team at Leipzig-Halle, where Rhodes crashes after Vision's misfire.

adds.title: Captain America: Civil War
adds.text: When Natasha backs the Sokovia Accords, Sam asks if she is the same woman who once told the government off. They end up on opposite sides at the Leipzig airport.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A friend who questions Natasha's support for the Accords.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A friend who backs the Accords while Sam refuses them.
adds.evidence: Accords debate at the Avengers Compound: Sam asks Natasha if she is the same woman who told the government to kiss her ass; Sam joins Rogers's team, Natasha Stark's, at Leipzig-Halle.

adds.title: Captain America: Civil War
adds.text: Natasha signs the Sokovia Accords and comes to Peggy's funeral so Steve is not alone. At the Leipzig airport she lets him and Bucky escape rather than fight him.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A close friend Natasha comforts at Peggy's funeral and lets escape at the airport.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A close friend who comforts Steve at Peggy's funeral and lets him escape.
adds.evidence: Romanoff finds Rogers after Peggy Carter's funeral ('I didn't want you to be alone'); at Leipzig-Halle she lets Rogers and Barnes go and holds off Black Panther.

adds.title: Captain America: Civil War
adds.text: Natasha sides with Tony on the Sokovia Accords and fights on his team at the Leipzig airport. After she lets Steve and Bucky go, they argue and he warns her that Ross is coming for her.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow Avenger Natasha backs on the Accords, then crosses at the airport.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow Avenger who backs Tony on the Accords, then lets Steve go.
adds.evidence: Romanoff agrees with Stark on the Accords and joins his team; after the airport battle they argue and Stark tells her T'Challa told Ross what she did, so they're coming for her. Romanoff goes into exile.

adds.title: Captain America: Civil War
adds.text: Natasha and Vision both sign the Sokovia Accords and fight on Tony's side at the Leipzig airport.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow signer of the Accords, on Tony's side at the airport.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow signer of the Accords, on Tony's side at the airport.
adds.evidence: Both take part in the Accords debate at the compound; Romanoff tells Rogers Vision has signed; both are on Stark's team at Leipzig-Halle.

adds.title: Captain America: Civil War
adds.text: Sam refuses the Sokovia Accords and stands with Steve, helping him protect Bucky and fighting at his side at the Leipzig airport. Sam is locked in the Raft, and Steve breaks him out.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Sam's friend, who breaks him out of the Raft.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Steve's friend, who sides with him against the Accords.
adds.evidence: Rogers and Wilson track Barnes to Bucharest, go rogue, fight at Leipzig-Halle; Wilson is detained at the Raft and Rogers breaks his allies out.
